newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat ends up on frost and seedings talk.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat ends up on frost and seedings talk.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures closed higher on talk of frost in Canadian wheat growing regions which may damage some of the crop, traders said.

A late soybean harvest in the U.S. Midwest which could slow seedings of the U.S. soft red winter wheat crop also boosted the market as did concern about wet weather in the U.S. Plains hard red winter region, they said.
Short covering also contributed to the advances.
"We had a pretty big slide in wheat and there's some talk in winter wheat of planting delays," said Ron Kucha of O'Connor and Co.
Wheat futures volume was estimated at 18,000 contracts, up from 17,018 Thursday, according to the CBOT.
In wheat options, Refco Inc bought 100 December $4.30 puts at 20-1/4, the traders said.
Options volume was estimated at 4,000, down from 6,426 Thursday.
